snippet.title: Abyssal Lapidary Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Abyssal Lapidary is a gothic management sim set in a Victorian-inspired underground metropolis. Appraise raw ores, cut exquisite gems, and craft unique jewelry for strange clients. 

Some stones are worth a fortune. Others stare back.

Join the playtest on Steam NOW: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3797790/_/
